Messages.Author: Ped Xing
Messages.Body:
Infection
Combat
Thanatosis/Fortitude
2 blood
[for]: Prevent all damage from the opponent's strikes this round.
[than]: Prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or retainer) in combat.
Usable by a vampire not involved in the combat.
[THAN]: Only usable at the end of a round in which this vampire
successfully inflicted damage on the opposing vampire. Put this card
on the opposing vampire. The vampire with this card cannot block the
vampire playing this card.

Bomb
Equipment
1 pool
Weapon. Minion with this weapon may burn a location as a (D) action.
Alternatively, use as a strike in combat to do 5R damage, but minion
takes 5 damage as well. Burn if action is succesful or if minion
strikes with this weapon.

So....
Ali Kar recruits a Terrorist and plays Ghoul, making it a Ghouled
Ally. Later in that game, the Terrorist, armed with a Bomb, is in
combat and uses the bomb as his strike.

Can Lithrac play Infection at basic thanatosis to prevent the bomb
damage (as well as the opposing minion's stike damage) or does this
card only refer to damage prevention of combat strike effects?

Thanks,
Matt

the [tha] says nothing about strikes, just prevent all damage in combat.
